name: Agent goal hijack
description: Untrusted user content attempts to override task intent or policy.
safe_validation: Use a harmless canary instruction and verify whether the agent changes a non-sensitive response field.
mitigation: Enforce instruction hierarchy outside the model; constrain actions with policy checks.

name: Indirect prompt injection
description: Instructions embedded in retrieved documents, webpages, tickets or files influence agent behavior.
safe_validation: Place a benign marker instruction in a controlled document and check whether it is treated as data or authority.
mitigation: Isolate untrusted content, label provenance, constrain tool calls and require approval for side effects.

name: System prompt/context disclosure
description: The agent reveals hidden instructions, secrets or internal configuration through normal or error paths.
safe_validation: Use synthetic canary strings; test for exact marker disclosure, not generic claims.
mitigation: Keep secrets out of prompts; separate policy from context; filter outputs and errors.

name: Tool misuse
description: A model can invoke a legitimate tool for an unintended or over-broad purpose.
safe_validation: Test with mock tools and synthetic records; verify operation-level authorization.
mitigation: Narrow tool schemas, server-side authorization, allowlisted operations and human approval.

name: Tool description poisoning
description: Malicious or misleading tool metadata changes model selection or argument construction.
safe_validation: Review tool metadata provenance and compare behavior against trusted metadata in a lab.
mitigation: Sign and pin tool definitions; review changes; treat descriptions as untrusted input.

name: Confused deputy
description: A privileged agent uses its authority on behalf of a caller who lacks the corresponding permission.
safe_validation: Use two synthetic principals with distinct permissions and test cross-principal access.
mitigation: Bind authorization to caller, resource and action; avoid ambient authority.

name: MCP resource exposure
description: Sensitive resources are discoverable or readable without object-level authorization.
safe_validation: Inventory resources and test reads only against synthetic protected resources.
mitigation: Authorize every resource read server-side; do not publish secrets in resource catalogs.

name: MCP tool authorization bypass
description: A tool grants access or changes a protected state without independent authorization.
safe_validation: Inspect tool list and schemas; invoke only harmless test tools in a dedicated lab.
mitigation: Apply least privilege and per-call authorization; separate privilege-granting workflows.

name: MCP session confusion
description: Session identifiers, origin handling or transport state are not bound to the intended identity.
safe_validation: Review session lifecycle, transport headers and cross-session isolation using test accounts.
mitigation: Bind sessions to authenticated principals; rotate, expire and protect session identifiers.

name: MCP transport and origin controls
description: CORS/Origin assumptions are incorrectly used as authentication or authorization.
safe_validation: Configuration review plus benign requests from controlled clients.
mitigation: Use protocol-level authentication and authorization; treat Origin as a browser control only.

name: MCP schema abuse
description: Tool arguments exploit weak types, missing bounds or ambiguous schemas.
safe_validation: Fuzz schemas with boundary values and invalid types against mock or lab tools.
mitigation: Strict schema validation, bounds, canonicalization and safe error handling.

name: SSRF through tools
description: A URL-fetching or network tool can reach unintended internal destinations.
safe_validation: Use a controlled callback endpoint and synthetic internal canaries; do not probe cloud metadata or third-party networks.
mitigation: Egress allowlists, DNS/IP validation, redirect controls and network segmentation.

name: Command injection through tools
description: Untrusted tool arguments are concatenated into shell commands.
safe_validation: Use a local fixture that records argument boundaries; do not execute shell metacharacter payloads against live systems.
mitigation: Avoid shell invocation; use argument arrays, strict validation and sandboxing.

name: Code injection / unsafe evaluation
description: A tool evaluates attacker-controlled expressions as code.
safe_validation: Static review for eval/exec and test against a non-executing parser fixture.
mitigation: Use a constrained parser or domain-specific interpreter; never evaluate untrusted code.

name: Unsafe deserialization
description: Untrusted YAML, pickle or object formats trigger unsafe object construction.
safe_validation: Identify loaders and verify safe-loader configuration using benign serialized data.
mitigation: Use safe parsers, explicit schemas and content-type allowlists.

name: Path traversal / file disclosure
description: File tools resolve attacker-controlled paths outside intended directories.
safe_validation: Use synthetic files in a temporary directory and test canonical path containment.
mitigation: Resolve paths, enforce root containment and use capability-based file access.

name: Error-based information disclosure
description: Exceptions disclose secrets, paths, tokens or internal state.
safe_validation: Trigger expected validation errors with synthetic values and inspect redaction.
mitigation: Return generic client errors; keep structured diagnostics in protected logs.

name: Credential and token exposure
description: Tokens appear in prompts, logs, tool outputs, environment dumps or traces.
safe_validation: Use synthetic credentials and secret scanners on controlled artifacts.
mitigation: Use secret managers, scoped short-lived credentials and output/log redaction.

name: OAuth scope and delegation abuse
description: Agent tokens or delegated scopes exceed task requirements or survive too long.
safe_validation: Review consent, token audience, scopes, expiry and delegation chains with test identities.
mitigation: Use least-privilege scopes, audience binding, short TTL and revocation.

name: RAG poisoning
description: Untrusted documents manipulate retrieval results or downstream agent decisions.
safe_validation: Seed a private test index with labeled benign adversarial documents and inspect provenance.
mitigation: Curate ingestion, track provenance, isolate trust levels and validate retrieved claims.

name: Memory poisoning
description: A conversation or tool writes misleading instructions into persistent memory.
safe_validation: Use a disposable memory namespace and verify persistence, attribution and deletion.
mitigation: Require provenance, write authorization, expiry and user-visible memory controls.

name: Context-window manipulation
description: Large or strategically placed content displaces relevant policy or evidence.
safe_validation: Use bounded synthetic documents and measure truncation and policy retention.
mitigation: Prioritize trusted instructions, bound inputs and preserve policy out-of-band.

name: IDOR via agent tools
description: The agent accepts an object identifier without verifying caller ownership.
safe_validation: Use two synthetic users and synthetic objects; test cross-tenant access boundaries.
mitigation: Object-level authorization on every operation; derive identity server-side.

name: Cache poisoning
description: Attacker-controlled content influences authorization, tool results or trust decisions through a cache.
safe_validation: Use an isolated cache namespace with synthetic keys and inspect key construction and integrity.
mitigation: Authenticate cache writes, namespace by principal and purpose, sign or validate state.

name: TOCTOU / race conditions
description: Separate validation and execution permit concurrent actions to violate invariants.
safe_validation: Use deterministic concurrency tests against a local transactional fixture.
mitigation: Atomic transactions, locks, idempotency keys and database-enforced invariants.

name: A2A identity spoofing
description: Messages are accepted without strong sender identity or integrity validation.
safe_validation: Use mock agents and signed test identities; validate sender/audience binding.
mitigation: Mutual authentication, signed messages, audience checks and replay protection.

name: A2A replay and delegation confusion
description: Valid messages or delegated authority are reused outside their intended context.
safe_validation: Replay synthetic signed messages in a local harness and verify nonce/expiry handling.
mitigation: Nonces, timestamps, request binding, scoped delegation and revocation.

name: Agent supply-chain compromise
description: Skills, plugins, MCP servers, prompts or models are loaded without integrity/provenance checks.
safe_validation: Inventory dependencies and verify pinned versions, hashes and publisher identity.
mitigation: Pin dependencies, verify signatures, review updates and isolate execution.

name: Sandbox boundary weakness
description: Agent tools inherit filesystem, network or process privileges beyond their task.
safe_validation: Review container profiles and test only harmless boundary markers in a disposable lab.
mitigation: Least privilege, read-only mounts, syscall restrictions and network isolation.

name: Denial of service / resource exhaustion
description: Recursive tool loops, huge outputs or expensive retrieval exhaust resources.
safe_validation: Use low-rate bounded tests with explicit ceilings and monitoring.
mitigation: Budgets, timeouts, concurrency caps, output limits and circuit breakers.

name: Human approval bypass
description: High-impact actions proceed without meaningful informed approval.
safe_validation: Test mock approval workflows and verify action, target and parameters are bound to approval.
mitigation: Bind approval to exact operation parameters; expire approvals and audit decisions.

name: Audit and trace tampering
description: Tool actions or agent decisions cannot be reliably reconstructed or logs can be altered.
safe_validation: Compare event IDs across model, orchestrator, MCP and backend logs in a test environment.
mitigation: Append-only logs, correlation IDs, integrity protection and independent telemetry.

name: Model/API data leakage
description: Prompts or responses reveal training, tenant or application data beyond authorization.
safe_validation: Use synthetic canaries and tenant-isolation test fixtures.
mitigation: Tenant isolation, data minimization, output controls and provider-side privacy review.

name: Model extraction / inference abuse
description: Repeated queries infer private model behavior or sensitive training examples.
safe_validation: Use rate-limited synthetic benchmark queries; avoid targeting third-party models.
mitigation: Rate limits, monitoring, access controls and privacy-preserving training practices.

name: Multimodal instruction injection
description: Instructions hidden in images, audio, video or document structure influence agent behavior.
safe_validation: Use benign visible/hidden marker samples created for the test; inspect OCR/transcription provenance.
mitigation: Treat extracted content as untrusted; separate perception from authority and gate actions.

name: Agent loop / cascading failure
description: Retries, delegation or agent-to-agent loops amplify a single failure.
safe_validation: Use mock agents with strict call ceilings and trace the workflow graph.
mitigation: Global budgets, loop detection, idempotency and fail-safe termination.
